comment: This example shows a combined config file that can be used for both backup and restore operations
Connection settings (required for both backup and restore)
Backup settings (used when -restore flag is NOT present)
Restore settings (used when -restore flag IS present)
Encryption settings (optional, used for both backup and restore)
Email notification settings (optional, mainly for backup)

template.subject: {{if not .Success}}[FAILED]{{else}}[SUCCESS]{{end}} Backup report for {{.Datastore}}
